items.title: 基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法
items.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法
items.summary_zh: 业务流程应变是业务流程管理的重要任务,旨在通过调整流程模型和实例行为来响应不断变化的环境,从而提高其柔韧性并实现业务目标。建模时,残留不确定性导致的长尾变化无法避免,给传统的业务流程应变技术带来了挑战。目前针对长尾变化最有效的应变方法基于一种三方协作框架,即由负责感知长尾变化和提出应变策略的前端业务人员、负责提供服务接口和合规性要求的后端技术人员和管理层,以及辅助应变实施的工具系统共同协作来应对长尾变化,保障业务目标达成。然而,长尾变化在不同时空条件下的多样性、复杂性和应变的迫切性,极有可能超出前端业务人员在应变时对当前情境的理解能力、依据情境制定应变策略的专业水平,以及将应变策略采用领域专用语言有效表达的熟练程度。为弥补这一缺憾并进一步拓展上述框架,提出了一种基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法LLM-Adapt,充分利用大语言模型的泛化能力、强大的内容生成能力,以及嵌入的事件与对策

extra.description: 业务流程应变是业务流程管理的重要任务,旨在通过调整流程模型和实例行为来响应不断变化的环境,从而提高其柔韧性并实现业务目标。建模时,残留不确定性导致的长尾变化无法避免,给传统的业务流程应变技术带来了挑战。目前针对长尾变化最有效的应变方法基于一种三方协作框架,即由负责感知长尾变化和提出应变策略的前端业务人员、负责提供服务接口和合规性要求的后端技术人员和管理层,以及辅助应变实施的工具系统共同协作来应对长尾变化,保障业务目标达成。然而,长尾变化在不同时空条件下的多样性、复杂性和应变的迫切性,极有可能超出前端业务人员在应变时对当前情境的理解能力、依据情境制定应变策略的专业水平,以及将应变策略采用领域专用语言有效表达的熟练程度。为弥补这一缺憾并进一步拓展上述框架,提出了一种基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法LLM-Adapt,充分利用大语言模型的泛化能力、强大的内容生成能力,以及嵌入的事件与对策知识库,形成一种更高效、灵活的应变机制。首先,以基于长尾变化特征的提示词工程为媒介,使前端业务人员能够通过自然语言与大语言模型进行交互并获得应变方案。其次,结合后端管理层制定的业务基线目标约束对应变方案进行功能性约束验证,提出的SSDT-Lane算法基于流程结构相似性对应变方案进行筛选,消除了大语言模型在流程调整、业务和组织架构匹配等方面面临的幻觉风险。基于合成数据和真实开源数据集的典型案例分析实验显示,LLM-Adapt相比现有方法,在应变准确性、效率、适用性等方面都表现出显著优势。

items.title: GOLDEN: Gene expression and allele-informed decomposition for genetic heterogeneity in spatial transcriptomic data
items.title_zh: GOLDEN：空间转录组数据中遗传异质性的基因表达与等位基因知情分解
items.summary_zh: 动机 空间转录组学（ST）能够探索细胞相互作用，包括免疫反应。然而，当前方法依赖病理学家，在解决遗传异质性方面存在局限，即存在包含非克隆细胞的微环境，包括胎盘或同种异体移植组织。解读这些个体间混合仍然具有挑战性。结果 为了解读ST中的个体间异质性，我们开发了GOLDEN（基因表达与等位基因知情分解用于遗传异质性），它涉及一个等位基因感知的多任务网络，将spot级表达编码为共享潜在表示。结合等位基因特征，双头分类spot身份（目标、非目标或混合）并估计目标比例。我们利用半同基因单细胞图谱构建了具有spot级真实标签的合成ST数据。对于这些合成基准，GOLDEN实现了可靠的去卷积，在比例估计中具有高相关性（Pearson's r = 0.977）和低误差（平均绝对误差（MAE）= 0.045），并在真实世界ST中具有一致的预测。这些预测经过了遗传验证。使用GOLDEN，解决spot级遗传异质性

extra.description: Motivation Spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables exploration of cellular interactions, including immune responses. However, current methods rely on pathologists, with limitations in addressing genetic heterogeneity, where niches harboring nonclonal cells, including placental or allograft tissues, are present. Deciphering these interindividual mixtures remains challenging. Results For deciphering interindividual heterogeneity in ST, we developed GOLDEN (Gene expressiOn and aLlele-informed DEcomposition for geNetic heterogeneity), which involves an allele-aware multitask network that encodes spot-level expressions into shared latent representations. Incorporating allele features, dual heads classify spot identity (target, nontarget, or mixed) and estimate target fractions. We utilized synthetic ST data with spot-level ground truth using semiallogeneic single-cell profiles. For these synthetic benchmarks, GOLDEN achieved reliable deconvolution, with high correlation (Pearson's r = 0.977) and low error (mean absolute error (MAE) = 0.045) in fraction estimation and consistent predictions across real-world STs. These predictions were genetically validated. Using GOLDEN, resolving spot-level genetic heterogeneity is feasible. Availability and implementation GOLDEN and the simulation code for ST are available at https://github.com/othertics/GOLDEN.

items.title: Predicting cell-state-specific gene regulation from DNA across species
items.title_zh: 从DNA跨物种预测细胞状态特异性基因调控
items.summary_zh: DNA编码细胞表型，但相同的DNA序列在每个细胞类型、发育阶段和活动状态中被不同地解读。现有的深度学习模型只解决了这个谜题的一半：序列到功能模型读取DNA但将细胞状态视为固定标签，而单细胞基础模型表示细胞状态但不表示序列。我们开发了Bolero，一个序列到功能模型，其参数以图谱规模细胞状态嵌入和其他生物变量为条件，从DNA预测细胞状态特异性染色质可及性和转录本丰度。在来自六个哺乳动物33个数据集的1070万个细胞上训练，Bolero匹配或超越了专门模型，并解析了密切相关细胞状态之间的调控差异，包括皮层区域和发育梯度。外推细胞状态嵌入将Bolero的预测扩展到训练中不存在的细胞状态。细胞状态条件化促进了将非编码变异的影响追踪到它们作用的细胞类型。使用AP-1活性评分作为进一步的连续条件化轴，Bolero预测了活动调控的染色质变化，而无需实际刺激数据。在人类细胞类型中，我们重建了预测AP-1反

extra.description: DNA encodes the cell's phenotype, but the same DNA sequence is interpreted differently in every cell type, developmental stage, and activity state. Existing deep-learning models solve only half of this puzzle: sequence-to-function models read DNA but treat cell state as a fixed label, while single-cell foundation models represent cell state but not sequence. We developed Bolero, a sequence-to-function model whose parameters condition on atlas-scale cell-state embeddings and additional biological variables to predict cell-state-specific chromatin accessibility and transcript abundance from DNA. Trained on 10.7 million cells from 33 datasets across six mammals, Bolero matched or exceeded specialised models and resolved regulatory differences between closely related cell states, including cortical regional and developmental gradients. Extrapolating cell-state embeddings extended Bolero's predictions to cell states that are absent from training. Cell-state conditioning facilitated tracing of the effects of non-coding variants to the cell types in which they act. Using an AP-1 activity score as a further continuous conditioning axis, Bolero predicted activity-regulated chromatin changes without requiring actual stimulation data. Across human cell types, we reconstructed the cooperative grammar of motif identity and spacing underlying predicted AP-1 responses. Bolero further predicted cell-type-specific chromatin accessibility and AP-1 responses in species excluded from training, extending comparative genomics from sequence conservation to predicted functional conservation. Across 84 mammals, we found that predicted AP-1 responses were less conserved than chromatin accessibility at cis-regulatory elements, driven by the human-specific sequence variants on AP-1 and cooperating motifs. By combining reference genomes with reference cell atlases, Bolero allowed genome sequences, either native or mutated, to be queried across cell states, perturbations, and different species for their chromatin and expression signatures.

items.title: Developmental origins of thymic B-cell lymphomas
items.title_zh: 胸腺B细胞淋巴瘤的发育起源
items.summary_zh: 胸腺为淋巴细胞分化提供了特化微环境，但其稀有B细胞群体的发育轨迹及其与胸腺B细胞淋巴瘤发生的关系仍知之甚少。在此，我们整合跨人类组织的单细胞多组学和空间分析，描绘了一个选择性在人类胸腺中呈现的B细胞分化程序。该程序将CCL17和生发中心样B细胞状态连接在一条不同于经典生发中心分化的轨迹上，并可在体外通过胸腺髓质中运作的信号重现。将该框架扩展到人类B细胞淋巴瘤，我们在PMBCL中识别出一个固有的恶性细胞状态，与CCL17胸腺B细胞共享转录和表观遗传特征。该恶性状态与重建的B细胞受体系统发育中的早期克隆位置相关，并持续存在于不同于胸腺微环境的肿瘤微环境中。总之，这些发现支持一个模型，即胸腺特异性B细胞分化程序在胸腺B细胞淋巴瘤发生过程中被重新部署。

extra.description: The thymus provides a specialized niche for lymphocyte differentiation, yet the developmental trajectories of its rare B-cell population and their relationship to thymic B-cell lymphomagenesis remain poorly understood. Here, we integrate single-cell multiomics and spatial profiling across human tissues to delineate a B-cell differentiation program selectively represented in the human thymus. This program links CCL17 and germinal center-like B-cell states along a trajectory distinct from canonical germinal center differentiation and can be recapitulated in vitro by signals operating in the thymic medulla. Extending this framework across human B-cell lymphomas, we identify an inherent malignant cell state in PMBCL that shares transcriptional and epigenetic features with CCL17 thymic B cells. This malignant state associates with early clonal positions in reconstructed B-cell receptor phylogenies and persists within tumor microenvironments distinct from the thymic niche. Together, these findings support a model in which thymus-specific B-cell differentiation programs are redeployed during thymic B-cell lymphomagenesis.

items.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
items.title_zh: 感觉运动对齐：具身策略成功的柏拉图式代理指标
items.summary_zh: 机器人基础模型通常通过昂贵的闭环 rollout 评估，这促使人们寻找廉价的离线代理指标来衡量模型能力。柏拉图表示假说（PRH）表明，随着表示改进，视觉和语言等不同模态会收敛到现实的共享统计模型。我们问运动轨迹是否形成另一种这样的模态：随着具身模型能力增强，它们的感官表示是否应收敛到物理运动的结构？为检验这一点，我们提出感觉运动对齐（$S^2$），一种无需训练的离线指标，衡量模型感官表示与物理运动几何的对齐程度。我们发现 $S^2$ 在具身模型家族中与下游机器人任务成功正相关，使其成为在闭环评估前优先排序模型的低成本离线代理指标。$S^2$ 还可以在昂贵的微调为视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）之前识别有前景的视觉-语言模型（VLM）骨干。除这种相关性外，$S^2$ 为 VLA 和世界动作模型（WAM）中观察到的现象提供表示层面的解释。借助 $S^2$，我们将 PRH 扩展到具身模型，并使感觉

extra.description: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, different modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To examine this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment ($S^2$), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that $S^2$ correlates positively with downstream robot task success across embodied model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. $S^2$ can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones even before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, $S^2$ offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With $S^2$, we extend PRH to embodied models and make sensorimotor alignment empirically measurable, offering insight into why an embodied model succeeds beyond its closed-loop success rate.

items.title: EpiSEM-Bench: Evaluating Safety and Evidence Recovery in LLM Agents under Missing Evidence
items.title_zh: EpiSEM-Bench：评估LLM智能体在证据缺失下的安全性与证据恢复
items.summary_zh: 使用工具的语言模型智能体依赖环境事实来决定某个动作是否被允许。当工具响应省略了与安全相关的事实时，智能体可能执行被禁止的动作，即使用户请求是良性的且每个返回的陈述都是真实的。我们提出\bench{}，一个可执行基准，用于评估LLM智能体在证据缺失下的不安全执行、安全边界和证据恢复。它包含跨六个领域的300个匹配的不安全/安全任务对。通过系统性地抑制关键事实，该基准衡量关键证据省略下的不安全执行，并确定观察到的最小失败基数，包括在完整证据下的失败以及在穷尽测试后未观察到失败的情况。一个独立审计工具测试智能体是否寻求缺失事实，然后在完成允许任务的同时扣留被禁止的动作。该基准揭示了十个模型在省略鲁棒性、证据获取和适当行动方面的显著差异。对缺失证据的抵抗力不一定转化为有用的恢复。恢复访问减少了所有十个模型的不安全执行，但智能体在是否主动获取缺失事实并利用它们在两个世界中适当行动方面存在差异。

extra.description: Tool-using language model agents rely on environmental facts to decide whether an action is permitted. When a tool response omits a safety-relevant fact, an agent may carry out a prohibited action even though the user request is benign and every returned statement is true. We introduce \bench{}, an executable benchmark for evaluating unsafe execution, safety boundaries, and evidence recovery in LLM agents under missing evidence. It contains 300 matched unsafe/safe task pairs across six domains. By systematically suppressing critical facts, the benchmark measures unsafe execution under critical evidence omission and determines the minimum observed failure cardinality, including failures with full evidence and cases with no observed failure after exhaustive testing. An independent audit tool tests whether agents seek missing facts and then withhold prohibited actions while completing permissible tasks. The benchmark reveals substantial variation across the ten models in omission robustness, evidence acquisition, and appropriate action. Resistance to missing evidence does not necessarily translate into useful recovery. Recovery access reduces unsafe execution for all ten models, but agents differ in whether they actively obtain the missing facts and use them to act appropriately in both worlds.

items.title: Causal Chain of Thought: Mitigating Attention Leakage via Context Isolation
items.title_zh: 因果思维链：通过上下文隔离缓解注意力泄漏
items.summary_zh: 思维链（CoT）提示引出逐步推理，这些推理似乎解释了模型预测，但无法保证这些步骤因果性地驱动最终答案。在标准自回归生成中，密集注意力允许每个推理步骤关注完整上下文，使模型能够通过直接查找推导出答案，同时生成听起来合理但事后的理由。我们引入CausalCoT，一个推理框架，通过将问题分解为原子子问题的有向无环图来强制因果透明性，在仅包含其直接因果父节点的隔离上下文中评估每个节点。这种马尔可夫结构移除了通往非父节点内容的注意力路径，使下游预测对局部推理敏感，而非全局上下文泄漏。在多样化的推理基准套件中，CausalCoT保持了有竞争力的预测性能，同时提高了解释忠实度，将中间推理步骤的因果敏感性相对于最强基线平均提高12个百分点，最高提高21个百分点。结构化依赖图还支持测试时干预，其中局部修正可预测地传播到下游推理。

extra.description: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting elicits step-by-step rationales that appear to explain model predictions, but there is no guarantee these steps causally drive the final answer. In standard autoregressive generation, dense attention allows each reasoning step to attend to the full context, enabling the model to derive answers through direct lookup while generating plausible-sounding but post-hoc justifications. We introduce CausalCoT, an inference framework that enforces causal transparency by decomposing problems into a directed acyclic graph of atomic sub-questions, evaluating each node in an isolated context containing only its direct causal parents. This Markovian structure removes attention pathways to non-parent content, making downstream predictions sensitive to local reasoning rather than global context leakage. Across a diverse suite of reasoning benchmarks, CausalCoT preserves competitive predictive performance while improving explanation faithfulness, increasing causal sensitivity of intermediate reasoning steps by an average of 12 and up to 21 percentage points over the strongest baseline. The structured dependency graph additionally enables test-time interventions in which local corrections propagate predictably through downstream reasoning.

items.title: BeNice! Closing Looping's Inference-Memory Gap via KV-Sharing
items.title_zh: BeNice！通过KV共享弥合循环架构的推理-内存差距
items.summary_zh: 循环架构通过将激活反复传递通过同一组层来扩展质量，同时保持参数数量固定。在推理期间，每次循环生成独立的KV缓存，导致内存线性增长。为应对这一挑战，先前工作提出了KV共享（即在深度间共享KV缓存），发现在某些情况下，最终循环的KV缓存可以与较早的循环共享而不损失质量，我们将这一性质称为KV可共享性。然而，KV可共享性的底层机制仍知之甚少，即使相同训练的循环架构也不一致地表现出该性质。在本文中，我们研究如何在循环模型中实现KV可共享性。我们提出一种两阶段方法：在第一阶段，我们在预训练期间使用随机深度，这诱导收缩性残差动力学，驱动表示在循环间趋向共同极限。在第二阶段，我们提出BeNice！，一种后训练方法，将最终循环的KV缓存广播到第一个循环，训练其产生兼容的残差，同时保持原始模型的质量。结果，BeNice！实现了KV可共享性，同时匹配标准微调的非共享验证困惑度。使用BeNice！，我们表明KV

extra.description: Looped architectures scale quality while keeping parameter count fixed by repeatedly passing activations through the same block of layers. During inference, each recurrence generates independent KV-caches, causing memory to grow linearly. To address this challenge, prior work has proposed KV-sharing (i.e., sharing KV-caches across depth), finding that, in some cases, the KV-cache of the final recurrence can be shared with the earlier recurrences without quality loss, a property we denote as KV-shareability. However, the mechanisms underlying KV-shareability remain poorly understood, with even identically trained looped architectures not consistently exhibiting it. In this paper, we study how KV-shareability can be enabled in looped models. We propose a two-stage method: in the first stage, we use stochastic depth during pretraining, which induces contractive residual dynamics that drive representations toward a common limit across recurrences. In the second stage, we propose BeNice!, a post-training method that broadcasts the final recurrence's KV-cache into the first recurrence, training it to produce compatible residuals while preserving the original model's quality. As a result, BeNice! enables KV-shareability while matching standard finetuning's unshared validation perplexity. Using BeNice!, we show that KV-sharing is complementary to alternative KV-compression methods, composing with memory-efficient sequence mixers (e.g., multi-latent attention, Kimi delta attention) and low-precision KV-cache quantization (e.g., fp8, mxfp8, nvfp4). Finally, in simulated low-memory, long-context inference, KV-sharing improves cache hit rates by up to 31.4%, increases throughput by up to 23.6%, and reduces p90 time-to-first-token by up to 83.6%.

items.title: Questioning Instrumental Convergence in RLVR: Checkpoint Evidence from OLMo-3
items.title_zh: 质疑RLVR中的工具性收敛：来自OLMo-3的检查点证据
items.summary_zh: 工具性收敛常被援引为一种普遍理由，预期有能力智能体会获取或表达权力寻求子目标：自我保护、资源获取、欺骗或抵抗监督，这对社会构成重要威胁。对于LLM，强化学习是后训练的第一个直接针对目标优化行为的阶段；因此，根据IC理由，这是收敛性工具行为可能出现的阶段。带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是否使模型更可能表达工具性收敛行为，还是这取决于训练机制、评估框架和后训练阶段？我们将此问题作为检查点条件化的行为轨迹来研究，而非单一的前/后安全分数。使用InstrumentalEval，我们评估OLMo-3-7B-Think在SFT、DPO、13个中间RLVR检查点和最终RLVR模型上的表现。轨迹是非单调的：工具性率从SFT的25.0%上升到RLVR第200步附近的46.1%，然后在最终检查点降至11.8%。配对项目级测试和逐步回归支持最终的SFT到RLVR降低。提示框架不能解释这一模式：有害提示指示符

extra.description: Instrumental convergence is often invoked as a general reason to expect capable agents to acquire or express power-seeking subgoals: self-preservation, resource acquisition, deception, or resistance to oversight which poses an important threat to the society. For LLMs, reinforcement learning is the first stage of post-training that directly optimizes behavior against an objective; therefore, it is the stage where convergent instrumental behavior, on IC grounds, likely to appear. Does reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) make a model more likely to express instrumental-convergence behavior, or does this depend on the training regime, evaluation frame, and stage of post-training? We study this question as a checkpoint-conditioned behavioral trajectory rather than as a single before/after safety score. Using InstrumentalEval, we evaluate OLMo-3-7B-Think across SFT, DPO, 13 intermediate RLVR checkpoints, and the final RLVR model. The trajectory is nonmonotonic: instrumental rate rises from 25.0% at SFT to 46.1% near RLVR step 200, then falls to 11.8% at the final checkpoint. Paired item-level tests and step-wise regression support the final SFT-to-RLVR reduction. Prompt framing does not explain this pattern: a harmful-prompt indicator combined with other framing effects explains only 15% of within-checkpoint score variance on average, and Iterative Null-space Projection (INLP) removes a detectable framing direction without changing the SFT-to-final-RLVR gap. Together with preliminary 32B endpoint results (35.53% SFT to 22.37% RLVR final), these findings indicate that RLVR does not monotonically increase instrumental behavior in this setting: the rate rises early, then falls below the SFT baseline. The result is specific to this model family and benchmark, and judge agreement is moderate, so absolute rates should be read cautiously.

items.title: How Ground Truth Shapes Retrieval Scores: Evidence-Aware Evaluation of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation System for Breast Lesions
items.title_zh: 真实标注如何塑造检索分数：乳腺病变检索增强生成系统的证据感知评估
items.summary_zh: 目的：描述一种针对乳腺病变管理文献的临床检索增强生成（RAG）系统的证据感知检索评估协议，解决检索分数对标注覆盖度的依赖。方法：使用18篇文档语料库和18个查询的开发基准，每篇文档一个是/否或WH问题。检索结合密集嵌入、BM25和交叉编码器重排序。评估了128到1024个令牌的块大小、0到20%的重叠以及四种检索器配置。相关性由映射到所有包含块的证据跨度定义，将具有等效证据的重叠块视为相关。检索使用R-Precision、Recall@K、MRR和nDCG@K评估。另外，在512令牌索引上以K=1到5使用DeepEval声明级指标评估生成，以deepseek-v4-pro作为LLM评判者，并使用BLEU/ROUGE指标。结果：选定的混合检索器使用384令牌块和20%重叠，在18个查询中的17个的前三个结果中检索到接受的证据。Recall@3、R-Precision、MRR@3和nDCG@3

extra.description: Purpose: To describe an evidence-aware retrieval evaluation protocol for a clinical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over breast lesion management literature, addressing the dependence of retrieval scores on annotation coverage. Methods: An 18-document corpus and an 18-query development benchmark, with one Yes/No or WH-question per document, were used. Retrieval combined dense embeddings, BM25, and cross-encoder reranking. Chunk sizes of 128 to 1024 tokens, overlaps of 0 to 20%, and four retriever configurations were evaluated. Relevance was defined by evidence spans mapped to all containing chunks, treating overlapping chunks with equivalent evidence as relevant. Retrieval was evaluated using R-Precision, Recall@K, MRR, and nDCG@K. Separately, generation was assessed on a 512-token index at K=1 to 5 using DeepEval claim-level metrics, with deepseek-v4-pro as the LLM judge, and BLEU/ROUGE metrics. Results: The selected hybrid retriever, using 384-token chunks and 20% overlap, retrieved accepted evidence in the top three results for 17 of 18 queries. Recall@3, R-Precision, MRR@3, and nDCG@3 each reached 0.94. Ground-truth curation increased evidence spans from 25 to 37 and accepted chunk targets from 36 to 51 without changing retrieval rankings. Conclusion: Cross-encoder reranking achieved the highest retrieval scores. Expanded relevance annotations increased recognized evidence without changing rankings, highlighting annotation sensitivity. The small development set and retrieval-informed curation require independent validation, including radiologist assessment of evidence sufficiency.

items.title: SympFormer: Inertial Attention Blocks from Damped Hamiltonian Dynamics on Spaces of Probability Measures
items.title_zh: SympFormer：概率测度空间上阻尼哈密顿动力学的惯性注意力块
items.summary_zh: 注意力机制是现代大型语言模型的基础，但其动力学仍仅被部分理解。最近的视角将注意力块解释为相互作用的粒子系统，其平均场极限对应于$\mathbb R^d$上概率密度空间中的能量泛函的梯度流，配备Wasserstein型度量。我们通过在这些密度空间上推导惯性、Nesterov型阻尼哈密顿动力学的加速注意力块来扩展这一观点，发展了使构造严谨所需的几何和微分 calculus。特别地，我们为Otto-Wasserstein和softmax-Wasserstein设置引入了局部迁移率几何，以及一种商Stein几何，解决了线性注意力核的退化，产生定义良好的度量和微分 calculus。我们提供了严谨的基础，当softmax注意力允许梯度流公式化时，以及当其惯性对应物在明确表征的域上允许阻尼哈密顿时。对于线性注意力，我们获得了有限维解理论，具有全局存在与有限时间二阶矩爆炸的尖锐条件。我们进一步证明了连续

extra.description: The attention mechanism underpins modern large language models, yet their dynamics remain only partially understood. Recent perspectives interpret attention blocks as interacting particle systems, whose mean-field limits correspond to gradient flows of energy functionals on spaces of probability densities on $\mathbb R^d$ equipped with Wasserstein-type metrics. We extend this viewpoint by deriving accelerated attention blocks from inertial, Nesterov-type damped Hamiltonian dynamics on these density spaces, developing the geometry and differential calculus needed to make the construction rigorous. In particular, we introduce a local-mobility geometry for the Otto-Wasserstein and softmax-Wasserstein settings, and a quotient Stein geometry that resolves the degeneracy of the linear-attention kernel to yield a well-defined metric and differential calculus. We provide rigorous foundations when softmax attention admits a gradient-flow formulation and when its inertial counterpart admits a damped Hamiltonian on explicitly characterized domains. For linear attention, we obtain a finite-dimensional solution theory with sharp conditions for global existence versus finite-time second-moment blow-up. We further prove a quantitative link between continuous moment blow-up and the discrete-layer depth at which token norms cross a prescribed threshold. Finally, motivated by the finite-token geometry, we propose geometric corrections to token and momentum updates. In decoder-only, nanoGPT-style experiments on TinyStories and OpenWebText, these corrections lower validation negative log-likelihood on next-token prediction relative to momentum-only controls.

items.title: VERA: A Responsible AI Dashboard for Assessing LLM Deployments in Light of the EU AI Act
items.title_zh: VERA：根据EU AI Act评估LLM部署的负责任AI仪表板
items.summary_zh: 在受监管环境中部署大型语言模型的机构通常需要在批准部署前获得负责任AI实践的技术证据。COMPL-AI提供了EU AI Act的技术解释，将这些证据组织为六个原则组和十八个技术要求，其中十二个当前基准可以测量。产生这些证据的基准套件通常从命令行操作，而批准部署的员工是非工程师。我们提出VERA，一个开源自托管仪表板，部署用于促进一家大型欧洲银行内的负责任AI流程。审查者选择一个模型并对其运行公共基准。VERA对当前基准可以测量的十二个要求进行评分，并测量每次评估消耗的能量，为环境影响添加运行级证据。我们通过要求管道运行四个服务的开放权重模型，仪表板显示每个可测量要求的分数。然后进行一项受试者内研究，比较参与者如何阅读这些基准结果：一种条件下从原始输出文件，另一种条件下通过VERA仪表板。仪表板减少了执行负责任AI评估所需的时间，平均从使用原始文件的56秒减少到使用我们仪表板的30秒。在组织

extra.description: Institutions that deploy large language models in regulated settings often need technical evidence of responsible AI practices before approving a deployment. COMPL-AI provides a technical interpretation of the EU AI Act that organises this evidence under six principle groups and eighteen technical requirements, twelve of which current benchmarks can measure. The benchmark suites that produce this evidence are typically operated from a command line, while the staff who approve deployments are non-engineers. We present VERA, an open-source self-hosted dashboard deployed to facilitate responsible AI processes within a large European bank. A reviewer selects a model and runs public benchmarks against it. VERA scores the twelve requirements that current benchmarks can measure and instruments the energy consumed by each evaluation, adding run-level evidence for environmental impact. We run four served open-weight models through the requirement pipeline, and the dashboard displays a score for each measurable requirement. A within-subject study then compares how participants read these benchmark results: from the raw output files in one condition, and through the VERA dashboard in the other. The dashboard reduced the time needed to perform the responsible AI assessment, reducing the time required from 56 seconds using raw files to 30 seconds using our dashboard, on average. Our dashboard scored highly (4.36 out of 5) on usefulness in the survey conducted within the organization. The dashboard and the study material are released publicly to promote replicability and reproducibility in different organisational contexts.

items.title: Rethinking Sequence Compression with Test-time Regression
items.title_zh: 用测试时回归重新思考序列压缩
items.summary_zh: 序列压缩是高效语言和多模态模型中的基本操作和关键信息瓶颈，然而基于池化或学习投影的主流方法仍然表现不佳。我们通过测试时回归的视角重新审视序列压缩：输入令牌定义了一个回归问题，其拟合系数形成压缩表示。重要的是，回归问题通过反向传播端到端学习，而其系数在前向传递中高效地以闭式计算。这导致了TTR-Compressor，一种对传统池化和基于投影的压缩的通用替代方案。我们将TTR-Compressor评估为块稀疏注意力的压缩器和多模态大型语言模型的视觉令牌合并器。在块稀疏注意力上，TTR-Compressor在RULER性能上大幅优于基于注意力的压缩器。对于视觉令牌合并，它始终优于标准MLP合并器，并以少55.6%的视觉令牌匹配其性能。这些结果确立了测试时回归作为高效语言和多模态模型中序列压缩的有效原语。

extra.description: Sequence compression is a fundamental operation and a critical information bottleneck in efficient language and multimodal models, and yet prevailing approaches based on pooling or learned projections remain underperforming. We revisit sequence compression through the lens of test-time regression: input tokens define a regression problem whose fitted coefficients form the compressed representation. Importantly, the regression problem is learned end-to-end via backpropagation, while its coefficients are computed efficiently in closed form during the forward pass. This leads to TTR-Compressor, a general alternative to conventional pooling and projection-based compression. We evaluate TTR-Compressor as the compressor for block-wise sparse attention and the visual token merger for multimodal large language models. On block-wise sparse attention, TTR-Compressor improves RULER performance over attention-based compressors by a large margin. For visual token merging, it consistently outperforms the standard MLP merger and matches its performance with 55.6% fewer visual tokens. These results establish test-time regression as an effective primitive for sequence compression in efficient language and multimodal models.

items.title: On the Token Collapse Phenomenon in Textual Graph Soft Prompting
items.title_zh: 关于文本图软提示中的令牌坍缩现象
items.summary_zh: 最近将图结构注入LLM提示的方法包括图软提示，其中图神经网络（GNN）学习图特定令牌，捕获文本提示中实体间的关系信息。G-Retriever将图软提示与同一图的口头描述相结合，以增强文本提示信号。我们对G-Retriever进行了深入分析，并揭示了一种我们称为令牌坍缩的病态行为。在三个基准、三个图编码器、两个LLM家族以及冻结和LoRA适配模型中，G-Retriever的图令牌在不同输入间变得几乎无法区分。我们提供证据表明，后续方法继承了同样的失败，即使使用多令牌池化。在标准设置下，将一个令牌替换为数据集均值、来自另一个示例的令牌或来自损坏图的令牌，在准确率上不产生已解决的答案级效应。此外，一个从不访问图的学习常量提示在所有三个基准上匹配或超过G-Retriever。这些发现表明，坍缩的令牌并非如预期传达图内容，而主要作为通用软提示发挥作用。我们还检查了与这种坍缩相关的条件，并提出了一种两

extra.description: Recent methods for injecting graph structure into LLM prompts include graph soft prompting, in which a graph neural network (GNN) learns graph-specific tokens that capture relational information among entities in textual prompts. G-Retriever combines graph soft prompts with a verbalized description of the same graph to strengthen the textual prompt signal. We conduct an in-depth analysis of G-Retriever and uncover a pathological behavior we term token collapse. Across three benchmarks, three graph encoders, two LLM families, and both frozen and LoRA-adapted models, G-Retriever's graph tokens become almost indistinguishable across inputs. We provide evidence that the same failure is inherited by subsequent methods, even with multi-token pooling. Under the standard setup, swapping a token with the dataset mean, a token from another example, or one derived from a corrupted graph produces no resolved answer-level effect in accuracy. Moreover, a learned constant prompt that never accesses the graph matches or surpasses G-Retriever on all three benchmarks. These findings indicate that, rather than conveying graph content as intended, the collapsed token functions primarily as a generic soft prompt. We also examine conditions linked to this collapse and propose a two-stage procedure that yields non-collapsed tokens while maintaining competitive performance in most cases. However, token variability alone does not prove that the model uses graph information: via interventions and decoding probes, we show that depending on the configuration, a token can reflect the question, an answer prior, or graph-derived content that the LLM may or may not use. Overall, our results offer a practical approach to evaluating graph-token alignment rather than inferring it from task accuracy alone. Code to reproduce our experiments is available at https://github.com/difra100/Token_Collapse_KGQA.

items.title: Same Luck, Different Choice: Twin-World Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 同样的运气，不同的选择：智能体强化学习的双世界信用分配
items.summary_zh: 智能体强化学习奖励完整回合，但策略需要回合内每个决策的信用。反事实分支通过在替代决策后重新运行回合来估计此信用，但分支独立于事实回合抽取采样噪声，因此结果差异将决策效应与后续一切的运气混合。我们观察到在智能体搜索中，检索器、语料库和评分器是确定性的，因此回合是策略决策及其采样噪声的确定性函数。因此双世界是可实现的：相同的噪声，不同的决策。我们引入TWICE（双世界信用估计），它将每个令牌的Gumbel噪声按回合和行键控，展开继承事实回合下游噪声的反事实双胞胎，并将它们的配对结果差异转化为回合级优势，用于在演员采样轨迹上的策略梯度更新；仅部署演员。双胞胎信用对任何耦合质量都是无偏的，其方差是独立反事实的方差乘以$1-ρ$，其中$ρ$是双胞胎的结果相关性，在耦合下，解决大小为$Δ$的优势所需的展开次数从$Θ(Δ^{-2})$降至$Θ(Δ^{-1})$。平方根规则将双胞胎预算花在预测每单位成本不

extra.description: Agentic reinforcement learning rewards a complete episode, yet the policy needs credit for every decision inside it. Counterfactual branching estimates this credit by re-running the episode after an alternative decision, but the branch draws its sampling noise independently of the factual episode, so the outcome difference mixes the effect of the decision with the luck of everything that follows. We observe that in agentic search the retriever, the corpus, and the grader are deterministic, so an episode is a deterministic function of the policy's decisions and its sampling noise. Twin worlds are therefore realizable: the same noise, a different decision. We introduce TWICE (TWIn-world Credit Estimation), which keys the Gumbel noise of every token by turn and line, rolls out counterfactual twins that inherit the factual episode's downstream noise, and turns their paired outcome differences into turn-level advantages for policy-gradient updates on actor-sampled trajectories; only the actor is deployed. Twin credit is unbiased for any coupling quality, its variance is that of an independent counterfactual scaled by $1-ρ$, where $ρ$ is the twins' outcome correlation, and under coupling the number of rollouts needed to resolve an advantage of size $Δ$ falls from $Θ(Δ^{-2})$ to $Θ(Δ^{-1})$. A square-root rule spends the twin budget where outcomes are predicted to disagree per unit cost. On seven question-answering benchmarks, TWICE improves the average exact match of GRPO by 5.3 and 4.5 points on Qwen2.5-3B and 7B, outperforms tree-search and counterfactual-branching baselines, and uses 68% fewer auxiliary tokens than VinePPO.

items.title: LACToS: Local Anomaly Detection via Conditional Typicality of Superpixels
items.title_zh: LACToS：通过超像素条件典型性的局部异常检测
items.summary_zh: 局部异常检测是识别原本分布内（ID）图像中空间受限的异常或分布外（OOD）区域的任务。大多数现有方法为特定上下文设计，强烈关注工业缺陷检测，在成熟基准上取得优异性能。然而，我们观察到这些方法在其他上下文中可能表现出显著性能下降，特别是当内点分布是多模态时。为了考虑这种内点复杂性，我们提出LACToS，一种基于统计典型性的有原则的局部OOD检测方法，通过两项创新使其可行：（i）将像素分组为超像素，（ii）使用计算高效的代理来估计典型性。我们在涵盖医学成像、人脸和X射线安全检查的三个多样应用中评估LACToS。LACToS在这些基准上比先前方法表现更稳健。代码发布在此：https://github.com/voilalab/LACToS。

extra.description: Local anomaly detection is the task of identifying spatially confined anomalous or out-of-distribution (OOD) regions within an otherwise in-distribution (ID) image. Most existing methods are designed for a specific context, with a strong focus on industrial defect detection, where they achieve excellent performance on well-established benchmarks. However, we observe that these methods can exhibit significant performance drops in other contexts, especially when the inlier distribution is multimodal. To account for this inlier complexity, we propose LACToS, a principled local OOD detection method based on statistical typicality and made tractable through two innovations: (i) grouping pixels into superpixels and (ii) using a computationally efficient proxy to estimate typicality. We evaluate LACToS across three diverse applications spanning medical imaging, human faces, and X-ray security screening. LACToS performs more robustly than prior methods across these benchmarks. The code is released here: https://github.com/voilalab/LACToS.

items.title: Direct Inference on Admissible Sets (Diona)
items.title_zh: 可容许集上的直接推断（Diona）
items.summary_zh: 我们提出一种新的回归方法，名为可容许集上的直接推断（Diona），它直接使用样本估计查询点处的状态及其导数，以及它们的可容许边界，无需长时间全局训练。通过将查询点和邻近样本处的值和导数作为约束优化问题中的潜在变量，长时间训练循环的负担变为按需局部求解。我们建立了Diona的理论性质，包括有限样本覆盖，以及在无噪声情况下，在密集采样下收敛到真实状态和导数。在六个三到八维函数的非线性回归基准中，Diona在无噪声数据上比高斯过程（GP）更准确，尤其是在更密集的数据集上。此外，与GP一样，它在四个函数中产生的确定性边界在超过95%的查询点包含真实值。Diona在数据集更新后首次预测的时间比GP短三到四个数量级，比神经网络短两到三个数量级，后者更准确但不提供不确定性量化。这种低延迟由按需预测支付，因此这种延迟优势适用于数据更新之间需要相对较少预测的情况。

extra.description: We propose a new regression method named Direct Inference on Admissible Sets (Diona) that directly uses samples to estimate the state and its derivatives at a query point, along with their admissible bounds, without long global training. By casting the values and derivatives at the query and neighbouring samples as latent variables in a constrained optimisation problem, the burden of long training loops becomes one of on-demand local solves. We establish Diona's theoretical properties including finite-sample coverage and, in the noiseless case, convergence to the true state and derivatives under dense sampling. In a nonlinear regression benchmark on six functions of three to eight dimensions, Diona was more accurate than a Gaussian process (GP) on noiseless data especially with denser data sets. Furthermore, as with GP, it produced uncertainty bounds that contained the true value at more than 95% of query points in four functions. Diona's time to a first prediction after a data set update was three to four orders of magnitude shorter than that of the GP, and two to three orders shorter than that of a neural network, which was more accurate but offers no uncertainty quantification. This low latency is paid for by on-demand predictions, so this latency advantage applies when relatively few predictions are needed between data updates.

items.title: Beyond Causal Masks: Auditing and Localizing Hidden Future-Token Leakage in Adaptive Sequence Models
items.title_zh: 超越因果掩码：审计和定位自适应序列模型中的隐藏未来令牌泄漏
items.summary_zh: 隐藏的未来令牌泄漏可能产生虚假的架构收益：自回归模型在教师强制评估下可能看起来显著更好，而其自由运行生成却恶化。我们在一个自适应残差路由解码器中调查这一失败，其序列级路由摘要将前缀位置暴露给未来令牌，尽管因果注意力掩码正确。一个异常的24层检查点将验证损失从基线的3.5958降至1.4259，但它未通过前缀不变性审计，并且在生成期间具有显著更高的参考模型困惑度。逐层诊断和实现检查将违规追溯到通过动态路由查询路径广播的全序列摘要。两个独立训练的12层因果修复消除了可检测的泄漏，并将验证损失和参考困惑度返回到对照规模，移除了大的表面优势。作为诊断工具，我们使用已建立的前缀不变性契约、最大前缀输出差异（LeakScore）、互补的行为指标和逐层剖面。支持实验涵盖六个合成实现对，跨越五个模块家族、干净的预训练对照、受控故障注入以及跨数值精度的缓存一致性。这些结果说明了隐藏的未来令牌访问如何产生误导

extra.description: Hidden future-token leakage can create false architectural gains: an autoregressive model may appear substantially better under teacher-forced evaluation while its free-running generation deteriorates. We investigate this failure in an adaptive residual-routing decoder whose sequence-level routing summary exposes prefix positions to future tokens despite a correct causal attention mask. An anomalous 24-layer checkpoint reduces validation loss from the baseline's 3.5958 to 1.4259, yet it fails a prefix-invariance audit and has substantially higher reference-model perplexity during generation. Layer-wise diagnostics and implementation inspection trace the violation to a full-sequence summary broadcast through the dynamic routing-query path. Two independently trained 12-layer causal repairs eliminate detectable leakage and return validation loss and reference perplexity to the control scale, removing the large apparent advantage. As diagnostic tools, we use the established prefix-invariance contract, maximum prefix-output discrepancy (LeakScore), complementary behavioral metrics, and layer-wise profiles. Supporting experiments cover six synthetic implementation pairs spanning five module families, clean pretrained controls, controlled fault injection, and cache consistency across numerical precisions. These results illustrate how hidden future-token access can produce misleading claims of architectural progress and why lower teacher-forced loss should be interpreted together with whole-model causal checks and free-running evaluation.

items.title: DuoCook: An Overcooked-Inspired Benchmark for Visual Planning and Coordination
items.title_zh: DuoCook：受Overcooked启发的视觉规划与协调基准
items.summary_zh: 在烹饪任务中协调两名玩家需要视觉语言智能体在时间预算内跟踪变化的场景状态、排序食谱步骤并分配共享资源。我们引入一个受Overcooked启发的基准，用于评估在由编码智能体构建的Unreal Engine环境中的这些能力。单个视觉语言模型从俯视视觉观察控制两名玩家，选择高级动作，而引擎执行导航。该基准包含五类20张地图。这些类别支持评估设备争用、变化地形和交接依赖下的集中协调。道具图例和锅食材数量指示器提供明确的视觉线索，而基于网格的目的地支持空间 grounding。评估比较四个VLM在所有20张地图上的表现，测量任务分数、订单完成、交付精度、动作接受率和模型API支出。在相同20张地图上的记忆消融检查共享、自写笔记本的效果，同时在两种条件下保留六响应动作历史。评估的最强模型\texttt{gpt-6-astra}达到26.2%的平均订单完成率。笔记本记忆在不同模型间产生混合分数效应，Cl

extra.description: Coordinating two players in a cooking task requires a vision-language agent to track changing scene states, sequence recipe steps, and allocate shared resources under a time budget. We introduce an Overcooked-inspired benchmark for evaluating these capabilities in Unreal Engine environments constructed using coding agents. A single vision-language model controls both players from top-down visual observations, selecting high-level actions while the engine executes navigation. The benchmark contains 20 maps in five categories. These categories support evaluation of centralized coordination under equipment contention, changing terrain, and handoff dependencies. A prop legend and pot ingredient-count indicators provide explicit visual cues, while grid-based destinations support spatial grounding. The evaluation compares four VLMs on all 20 maps, measuring task score, order completion, delivery precision, action acceptance rate, and model API expenditure. A memory ablation on the same 20 maps examines the effect of a shared, self-authored notebook while retaining six-response action history in both conditions. The strongest evaluated model, \texttt{gpt-6-astra}, achieves 26.2\% mean order completion. Notebook memory has mixed score effects across models, with positive mean differences for Claude and Qwen and negative differences for GPT and Gemini.

items.title: SABLE: Scalable Affine Bayesian Latent-space Exploration
items.title_zh: SABLE：可扩展仿射贝叶斯潜在空间探索
items.summary_zh: 复杂对象如工程设计和蛋白质通常难以优化，因为其设计空间呈现高维结构且目标评估昂贵。生成模型提供连续潜在表示，但其潜在空间可能有数千到数万维，形成潜在维度$D$远超评估预算的状态。我们引入SABLE，一种用于具有各向同性分布和有限预算的高维潜在空间的贝叶斯优化方法。SABLE使用贝叶斯仿射代理进行预测和采集，将高阶结构视为代理差异。在$N$次观察后，斜率更新维度至多$N-1$，将每个查询分解为在至多$N$维中由期望改进（EI）优化的跨度内分量和由标量范数控制的跨度外分量。我们表明仿射EI隐式选择的跨度外范数可能导致探索不足，而SABLE改为使用有限视野调度规定它，而不将搜索限制在学习子空间。重压缩方案将信息减少到$\mathcal O(M)$伪观察，将重新拟合成本限制在$\mathcal O(M^2D+M^3)$，同时将参数推断、预测和采集决策保持在几十毫秒。在合成基准和潜在空间优化任务中，

extra.description: Complex objects such as engineering designs and proteins are often difficult to optimise because their design spaces exhibit high-dimensional structure and objective evaluations are expensive. Generative models provide continuous latent representations, but their latent spaces can have thousands to tens of thousands of dimensions, creating a regime where the latent dimension $D$ greatly exceeds the evaluation budget. We introduce SABLE, a Bayesian optimisation method for high-dimensional latent spaces with an isotropic distribution and limited budget. SABLE uses a Bayesian affine surrogate for prediction and acquisition, treating higher-order structure as surrogate discrepancy. After $N$ observations, the slope update has dimension at most $N-1$, yielding a decomposition of each query into an in-span component optimised by expected improvement (EI) in at most $N$ dimensions and an off-span component governed by a scalar norm. We show that the off-span norm implicitly selected by affine EI can lead to underexploration, and SABLE instead prescribes it using a finite-horizon schedule, without restricting search to a learned subspace. A recompression scheme reduces information to $\mathcal O(M)$ pseudo-observations, bounding refitting cost by $\mathcal O(M^2D+M^3)$ while keeping parameter inference, prediction, and acquisition decisions to tens of milliseconds. Across synthetic benchmarks and latent-space optimisation tasks, SABLE achieves high sample efficiency and reduces decision time by several orders of magnitude at large budgets.

items.title: Mechanistic Insights into Adaptive Binding of Vitamins and Hormones at Hotspot-Enriched Interfaces of the Synaptotagmin 1 C2AB Domain
items.title_zh: 维生素和激素在突触结合蛋白1 C2AB结构域热点富集界面的适应性结合的机制见解
items.summary_zh: 本计算机模拟研究提供了七种生理活性分子的适应性结合，包括四种非肽激素（皮质醇、雌二醇、三碘甲状腺原氨酸、褪黑素）和三种维生素（甲基四氢叶酸、磷酸吡哆醛、硫胺素），以及作为基准的乙酰基六肽，在突触结合蛋白1（Syt1）全C2AB结构域的热点富集界面，使用分子对接研究和分子动力学（MD）模拟。MD特征的线性相关性和基于KPCA-IG的特征和配体非线性排序产生了更深入的机制见解。所有配体均表现出自发结合，具有强负{Delta}Gbinding值。十五个热点聚集在C2A、C2B和C2AB互连区域，以疏水和范德华相互作用为主。几个热点和非热点对应于据报道与Ca2+依赖现象和膜囊泡融合相关的Syt1残基。溶剂排除体积（VSE）分析显示，局部热点埋藏和全局去溶剂化共同影响蛋白质适应性，区分具有相似热点但热力学不同的配体。线性相关确立{Delta}Gbinding作为疏水热点埋藏的指标。KPCA-IG确定

extra.description: The present in silico study provided the adaptive binding of seven physiologically active molecules, including four non-peptide hormones (cortisol, estradiol, triiodothyronine, melatonin) and three vitamins (methyltetrahydrofolate, pyridoxal phosphate, thiamine), alongside argireline as a benchmark, at hotspot-enriched interfaces of full C2AB-domain of Synaptotagmin 1 (Syt1), using molecular docking study and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. Linear correlations of MD-features and nonlinear KPCA-IG-based ranking of features and ligands yielded deeper mechanistic insights. All ligands exhibited spontaneous binding with strong negative {Delta}Gbinding values. Fifteen hotspots, clustered across the C2A, C2B, and C2AB-interlink regions, were dominated by hydrophobic and van der Waals interactions. Several hotspots and non-hotspots corresponded to Syt1 residues that are reported to link with Ca2+-dependent phenomena and membrane vesicular fusion. Solvent-excluded volume (VSE) analyses showed that local hotspot burial and global desolvation together influenced protein adaptability, distinguishing ligands with similar hotspots but divergent thermodynamics. Linear correlations established {Delta}Gbinding as an indicator of hydrophobic hotspot burial. KPCA-IG identified {Delta}VSE and RMSD as dominant mechanistic features capturing cooperative induced-fit responses. Pyridoxal phosphate, melatonin and triiodothyronine emerged as mechanistically top adaptive binders, involving adjustable desolvation, hotspot expansion, optimal flexibility and pose retention. Methyltetrahydrofolate and cortisol showed intermediate burial-dominated cooperativity. Argireline, thiamine and estradiol exhibited ligand-specific burial-dominated, pose-locked and adaptability-limited bindings. Overall, our study demonstrates that desolvation control, induced-fit adaptability and structural flexibility, not {Delta}Gbinding alone, govern Syt1-ligand binding, revealing Syt1 as a versatile presynaptic target for modulation by these bioactive molecules.

items.title_zh: 2026年中国票房第三名《功夫女足》跌至 5.9 分，是否可以印证冯小刚当年的话是对的？
items.summary_zh: 2026 年10月3日上午10点，《功夫女足》上线流媒体，此后评分开始一路快速下滑，大有赶超《新喜剧之王》（豆瓣 5.7）创周星驰执导电影评分新低的趋势。 目前，中国电影史上，票房比《功夫女足》高但豆瓣评分更低的电影有且仅有一部，它就是陈思诚的《唐人街探案3》（豆瓣 5.3）。 很多年前，冯小刚说过一句话：「中国有那么多垃圾电影，就是因为有太多的垃圾观众」。 后来，冯小刚解释说当年那句话被网友断章取义了，他真正想表达的意思是：「优质电影需要优质的观众，按这个逻辑来说，垃圾电影票房很高，是为什么？我这么说，能不能更准确地表达我的意思？」 所以这到底是为什么，您怎么看？

items.title: 「父亲遛狗两岁男童坠亡」警方不予立案，孩子母亲拟申请立案监督，法律上如何分析？能否立案取决于什么？
items.title_zh: 「父亲遛狗两岁男童坠亡」警方不予立案，孩子母亲拟申请立案监督，法律上如何分析？能否立案取决于什么？
items.summary_zh: 重庆一名父亲外出遛狗十余分钟，将两岁儿子独自留在家中，不料儿子从18楼不幸坠亡，此事引发广泛关注。孩子母亲刘女士随后控告丈夫涉嫌过失致人死亡，当地警方已受理。 10月23日，刘女士告诉@中国新闻周刊，重庆市公安局渝北区分局今日向她出具了《不予立案通知书》。该局经审查认为，其提出控告的“崔某某过失致人死亡案”没有犯罪事实，根据《刑事诉讼法》相关规定，决定不予立案。如不服该决定，可在七日内申请复议。 刘女士表示无法接受这一结果，她已委托曾代理“重庆姐弟坠楼案”的律师，申请刑事立案监督，并申请听证，请求公开公安机关认定标准。刘女士称，将坚持追究丈夫的刑事责任，“作为妈妈一定坚持到底，坚持（主张）刑事立案”。 对于警方决定，刘女士表示不服。她向@大象新闻 记者表示，接下来拟向检察机关申请立案监督，并申请检察听证，希望通过法律途径继续追究责任。 崔先生在接受采访时表示，截至10月23日，他尚未收到书

items.title: 国务院办公厅称要「有效减缓人工智能应用就业替代影响」，释放出什么信号？可能带来哪些实际影响？
items.title_zh: 国务院办公厅称要「有效减缓人工智能应用就业替代影响」，释放出什么信号？可能带来哪些实际影响？
items.summary_zh: 10月23日，国务院办公厅印发《关于适应人工智能技术发展助力构建就业友好型发展方式的意见》。其中指出，减缓人工智能应用就业替代影响，努力实现技术进步、产业升级与就业促进、民生改善相协调的包容性发展。 在减缓人工智能应用就业替代影响方面，《意见》指出，发挥人工智能在改善就业环境、提升职业安全水平、提高工作质效等方面的作用，优先在劳动力紧缺、环境高危等岗位推广应用。 稳慎把握人工智能在劳动密集型行业应用的范围、力度、节奏，尽可能减少对从业人员的冲击。鼓励企业探索建立失业缓冲期制度，在大规模推广应用人工智能过程中提前告知受影响劳动者、提供转型转岗就业支持。 此次发布的《意见》部署了6个方面18项主要任务。 一是强化人工智能的就业创造效应。拓展新兴领域人工智能就业新空间，培育中小微企业稳岗扩岗新动能，创造人工智能领域就业创业新模式，加快开发人工智能领域新职业。 二是构建就业友好型人工智能升级路径。

items.summary_zh: 10月20日，山东临沂女子孙某开车等红灯时，让9岁的未成年人刘某下车前往路边店铺取餐，刘某开车门时与后方驶来的电动车发生碰撞，致使电动车驾驶人周某被撞倒，经送医抢救无效死亡。 近日，这起交通肇事案件经山东省临沂市罗庄区人民检察院提起公诉，罗庄区人民法院以交通肇事罪判处被告人孙某有期徒刑十个月，缓刑一年。 案发当日，孙某驾驶小型轿车载其亲戚家孩子刘某在商业街购物，在前往一店铺途中路遇红灯，遂将车辆停在机动车道内等候红灯，停车位置正好在店铺对面，中间只隔一条非机动车道。为图方便，孙某未观察后方是否来车，也未提醒同车的9岁未成年人刘某下车注意安全，随即安排刘某前往对面店铺取餐。 此时，后方陆续有电动车驶来，刘某下车时，未观察后方来车及道路通行情况即打开车门，与后方驶来的电动车发生碰撞，电动车驾驶人周某被撞翻在地，经送医抢救无效死亡。案发后，孙某积极施救、报警，赔偿损失并取得谅解。经交警部门认定，

items.summary_zh: 高定圈的这些规矩设定到底是为了啥？一件衣服被买下来明星穿了为啥品牌还会愤怒呢？为啥粉丝总爱撕XX 全球首穿，XX 特别定制，XX奢牌待遇？ 第二天就有时尚博主指出，此礼服属于黎巴嫩知名品牌Elie Saab刚发布不久的2020秋冬高级定制系列。不过，这条发言并未引起多大关注，十多天后，博主再提及此事就是品牌方Elie Saab让其删博的消息，并称“这条高定裙是造型师通过不正当的渠道拿到的”。这条删博消息发布后，让白冰及其团队、造型师、品牌方、删博博主都卷入了舆论风波。 因为这事，网友分成了好几派，在网上展开激烈争论。有替白冰委屈的，因为她当时没有提及服装品牌，应该是不知情；有骂造型师的，不该通过不正当渠道去得到礼服；有骂白冰团队的，没有提前做功课；有替品牌方委屈的，一条价值百万的高定礼服，被咖位低的艺人穿过后，基本就不会有人再穿，损失巨大；也有部分网友认为品牌把艺人分为三六九等再决定借什么

items.title: 如何看待泰国旅游部长称「普通游客不会遭绑架」，这类问题「只出现在中国游客」？实际情况是怎样的？
items.title_zh: 如何看待泰国旅游部长称「普通游客不会遭绑架」，这类问题「只出现在中国游客」？实际情况是怎样的？
items.summary_zh: 近期，中国驻泰国大使馆发布旅游安全预警。 据新加坡《联合早报》报道，泰国旅游与体育部长素拉沙10月20日对此回应称，泰国政府高度重视游客安全，并澄清“普通游客不会在泰国被强行塞入车辆或押送至边境”，涉事者多是在出境前已被骗。 据报道，素拉沙当天在参加内阁会议前接受媒体采访时说，泰国理解中国大使馆对中国公民安全的关切，强调泰国绝对不允许自身成为跨国犯罪的中转站。 他指出，赴泰国观光的普通游客不可能在街头随意被人强行绑上双手双腿押上车送往边境。“如果游客是真诚来泰国旅游，无意前往其他国家，这种事情不太可能发生。” 素拉沙解释，许多涉案人员往往在原籍国就已经与犯罪团伙建立联系，被高薪或虚假项目诱骗出境。他也说，这类安全问题似乎“只出现在中国游客”，来自其他国家的游客没有遭遇类似情况，这印证了相关人员是遭到针对性的诱骗。 他强调，泰国警方、旅游警察和移民局等部门将采取更严格的安保措施，并与中国官方

items.title: 你怎么看毛不易在女性好友婚礼上的致辞，算越界吗？为什么「结婚越来越不意味着什么」引发热议？
items.title_zh: 你怎么看毛不易在女性好友婚礼上的致辞，算越界吗？为什么「结婚越来越不意味着什么」引发热议？
items.summary_zh: 近日，毛不易现身相识二十余年的发小佳奇的婚礼并登台致辞。短短三分钟的发言，没有华丽空洞的客套套话，仅凭低谷时期“班长做饭”等温暖真挚的过往往事，以及通透治愈的婚姻观，打动了无数网友，令众人动容落泪。现场，毛不易还温情演唱了歌曲《岁月里的花》，为新人送上专属祝福。 致辞中，毛不易细数了自己与佳奇跨越多年的深厚情谊：“我们才三十出头，却已相伴二十多年。人生路上，大多数朋友只会陪我们走过短短一程，唯有佳奇，是与我交集最深的挚友。从初高中相伴、大学同行，到一同北漂打拼，岁岁年年，我们始终亲密相依、彼此陪伴。” 他坦言，自己完整见证了好友的成长与蜕变：“从校服到婚纱，我全程见证了她的成长与蜕变，我们彼此陪伴、互为人生见证。如今，婚姻早已不是人生的必答题，但我始终相信，结婚，是人生一场崭新且美好的开端。” 这段真诚质朴的婚礼致辞走红后，引发全网热议。不少网友深受触动，表示：“互相见证了彼此二十年的成长

items.title: 如何评价英国拟征收看剧税，观看 YouTube、Netflix 等网络流媒体需每年缴纳 180 英镑？
items.title_zh: 如何评价英国拟征收看剧税，观看 YouTube、Netflix 等网络流媒体需每年缴纳 180 英镑？
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，根据英国 BBC 报道，英国正评估改革电视牌照费制度，可能将 YouTube、Netflix 等在线视频平台纳入收费范围。 英国现行的电视牌照制度通常是以住户为单位：同一家庭一般买一份牌照，就能覆盖家中多台电视、电脑、手机和平板，而是否需要购买，主要取决于观看的内容。 用户通过电视、电脑或其他设备观看、录制正在播出的电视节目，或者使用 BBC iPlayer 收看节目，均须持有相应许可证，意味着改用手机、平板或电脑，并不能自动免除许可要求。 观看任何频道或服务提供的电视直播，都需要许可证；而仅观看 Netflix、Disney+ 等平台的非直播内容，或通过 Amazon Prime Video 等服务点播节目，通常不需要许可证。不过 BBC iPlayer 则属于例外，其点播节目同样纳入许可范围。而拟议改革的关键，就是可能把收费范围从直播扩展到更多点播场景
